t: Launch of an electric battery manufacturing facility
d: Vladimir Putin took part, via videoconference, in a ceremony to launch an electric battery manufacturing cluster.

t: Greetings to the participants, organisers and guests of the You’re Super! International Singing Competition
d: Vladimir Putin sent greetings to the participants, organisers and guests of the You’re Super! International Singing Competition on its 10th anniversary.

t: Greetings on the opening of the 3rd Council of Regions of Russia and Uzbekistan
d: Vladimir Putin sent a message of greetings to the participants, organisers, and guests of the 3rd Council of Regions of Russia and Uzbekistan.

t: On October 8–9, Vladimir Putin will make a working visit to Turkmenistan
d: The President of Russia will attend a meeting of the CIS Council of Heads of State and the Caspian Environmental Summit. Both events will be held in Turkmenistan's national tourist zone of Awaza.
